newsitem.title: USA: WinStar in interconnect pact with US West.
newsitem.headline: WinStar in interconnect pact with US West.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc said Friday it has signed an interconnect agreement with U S West Communications Group covering the state of Colorado. U S West is the primary incumbent local exchange carrier there.

WinStar plans to provide competitive local telecommunications services in Denver later this year and said that this agreement establishes the terms under which it and U S West will interconnect their networks in Colorado.

WinStar already has interconnection agreements with all seven regional Bell operating companies, GTE Corp , and Sprint Corp. These agreements cover 28 of the major markets in which it plans to roll out its competitive local exchange carrier business over the next three years.
The company said it is negotiating agreements with a number of local exchange carriers for additional markets.
